articles.title: Klimawandel: UN-Generalversammlung verpflichtet Länder zu mehr Klimaschutz
articles.teaser: Die UN-Vollversammlung hat eine wegweisende Klimaresolution verabschiedet. Die USA stimmten dagegen. Basis ist ein Gutachten, das der Inselstaat Vanuatu initiiert hatte.
articles.image_title: Klimawandel: HAGONOY, PHILIPPINES - AUGUST 12: An aerial view taken with a drone shows abandoned homes in an island as seawaters have encroached amid rising tides on August 12, 2025 in Hagonoy, Philippines. In the Philippines’ coastal communities, the water has been rising for years—a slow, relentless encroachment fueled by melting ice sheets in Antarctica, the sinking of land from decades of unchecked groundwater extraction, and the swelling seas of a warming planet. But residents say the sharpest surge came with large-scale reclamation and other man-made coastal developments, which have altered currents and forced the tide farther inland. Now, even the gentlest tide can unleash deep floods, drowning streets and homes in minutes, a daily reminder of how human activity can accelerate a disaster already set in motion by climate change. (Photo by Ezra Acayan/Getty Images)

articles.title: Nachrichtenpodcast: Gegen diese Art von Ebola gibt es noch keinen Impfstoff
articles.teaser: Die WHO ruft wegen des Ebolaausbruchs den Gesundheitsnotstand aus. Warum gibt es noch keinen zugelassenen Impfstoff? Und: Seeleute sitzen in der Straße von Hormus fest.
articles.image_title: Nachrichtenpodcast: A port health officer sanitizes the hands of motorbike riders at the Busunga border crossing between Uganda and the Democratic Republic of Congo in Bundibugyo, on May 18, 2026. Ugandan officials confirmed that a 59-year-old man from Democratic Republic of Congo had died in Kampala after being admitted earlier in the week. Tests showed the victim in Uganda was infected with the Bundibugyo strain of Ebola, first identified in 2007. The World Health Organization declared an international health emergency on May 17, 2026 over an outbreak of an Ebola strain in the Democratic Republic of Congo that has killed more than 80 and for which there is no vaccine. Fears of further spread grew when a laboratory confirmed a case in the major eastern DRC city of Goma, which is controlled by the Rwanda-backed M23 militia.

articles.title: Kernfusion: Bundesregierung erwartet Bau von Fusionskraftwerk in 2040er-Jahren
articles.teaser: Die Regierung strebt an, bis Ende der 2030er den weltweit ersten Demonstrator für ein Fusionskraftwerk zu bauen. Darauf soll das erste kommerzielle Kraftwerk folgen.
articles.image_title: Kernfusion: GREIFSWALD, GERMANY - AUGUST 09: A worker ascends stairs at the Wendelstein 7-X stellarator on the day of a celebration to mark its readiness for a new phase of experiments at the Greifswald division of the Max Planck Institute for Plasma Physics (IPP) on August 09, 2022 in Greifswald, Germany. The Wendelstein 7-X is scheduled to begin its main objective this fall, namely a sustained and contained 100 million degree Celsius plasma discharge for 30 minutes. The device is the world's biggest of its kind and is paving the way for operational nuclear fusion technology, which, if successful, would revolutionize electricity production. Nuclear fusion fuses hydrogen nuclei to form helium, which generates energy from a nearly endless supply of hydrogen on the Earth. (Photo by Sean Gallup/Getty Images)

articles.title: Aufrüstung in Japan: Kein Raum für Pazifismus in einer rauen Welt
articles.teaser: Putin, Xi und Trump haben es geschafft, dass auch friedliche Mächte jetzt stark aufrüsten und neue Verbündete suchen. Das beste Beispiel ist Japan.
articles.image_title: Aufrüstung in Japan: SAN ANTONIO, ZAMBALES, PHILIPPINES - APRIL 28: Japanese Self-Defense Forces personnel stand guard in front of a surface-to-air guided missile system, during an Integrated Air and Missile Defense (IAMD) drill, as part of the ongoing Balikatan (Shoulder-Shoulder) multinational exercise, at a naval base in San Antonio, Zambales, Philippines, on April 28, 2026. The IAMD exercise, which sees the deployment of troops and missile systems from the United States and Japan, comes at a time of escalating tensions in the disputed South China Sea and the Taiwan Strait, with the Chinese People's Liberation Army increasing military activities in the water and Beijing denouncing Tokyo's strengthened defense cooperation with the Philippines.
